notes.title: Added some production units for foreign factions.
notes.content:
- Added some production units for foreign factions.
- Added some translations for DLC units.

notes.title: Build for DLC - added mage tower.
notes.content:
- A Mage Tower has been added for the DLC. Mages act as allies and travelers, but if you interfere with them and enter their territory, they will defend themselves.
- The Abandoned Port also received units that will fight after exploring it.

Thank you to everyone who supported the project. Thanks to you, we were able to create a truly unique game.

notes.title: Preparations for the upcoming expansion.
notes.content:
- Preparations for the upcoming expansion.
- Change the font in the loading component to display the "Loading" text also in russian language.
- Maximum unit selection for an army reduced to 4, as this is the maximum units allowed per location.

notes.title: Completed translations and added the Lion Rider unit.
notes.content:
- Completed translations.
- Added the Lion Rider unit for Persia. ( replacement for the Pegasus Rider )

notes.title: New special abilities have been added for units.
notes.content:
- Spartan Hoplites, Myrmidons, Lochagos, and Immortals now have the Shield Wall ability.
- Cavalry now has an additional charge ability.

notes.title: Spanish translation added.
notes.content:
- Spanish translation added.

Thank you for all your support and for purchasing the game. 
Thanks to you, we're able to increase the quality and scale of our game.

notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese translation added.
notes.content:
- Brazilian Portuguese translation added.
- Added some minor fixes to the Persia faction tutorial.

notes.title: Added Mage unit for Persia
notes.content:
[p]- Added Mage unit for Persia
- Added some missing tooltips. ( mainly for persian entities ).[/p][p]- Prices for advanced units have been balanced.[/p][p][/p][p]We appreciate every purchase of the game. It allows us to continue developing this product.[/p]

notes.title: Minor improvements.
notes.content:
[p]- Sacred mountain can produce unique units like Chimera etc.
- Few other minor improvements.
[/p][p]Your support helps us develop this product. Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Activated achievements for defeated creatures that were previously inactive.
notes.content:
- Activated achievements for defeated creatures ( Medusa, Silver Dragon, Green Hydra and Desert Hydra, Demigod, Giant ) that were previously inactive.

Your support helps us develop this product. Thank you.

notes.title: Added Desert Hydra location for the Desert Biome.
notes.content:
- Added Desert Hydra location for the Desert Biome.
- Some minor fixes for gameplay and translations.

Your support helps us develop this product. Thank you.

notes.title: Added Japanese translation.
notes.content:
- Added Japanese translation.
- Improved the performance of some technologies for the Persian faction.
- Fixed minor description errors.

notes.title: Added some missing translations for Simplified Chinese
notes.content: Added some missing translations for Simplified Chinese.

notes.title: The Persian faction has been added to the base game.
notes.content:
- The Persian faction with 7 units with unique statistics has been added to the game.
- Made a few minor fixes.

Ultimately, we decided that the base game should have another faction.

Thank you for purchasing it. It is thanks to you that we can develop this product.

notes.title: Game Release 1.05
notes.content:
- more translations for Simplified Chinese.
- added new residents traveling within the kingdom for the Marketplace, Forum, and Temple of Zeus.
